prompt: A developer wants the top scorer of the leaderboard but the script prints bob. Which line is wrong?
explanation: ZRANGE without REV walks the sorted set from the lowest score upward, so index 0 is bob with 90 points. Reading the top of the ranking needs the reversed direction: ZRANGE leaderboard 0 0 REV, or ZREVRANGE on older Redis versions.
codeLines: ZRANGE leaderboard 0 0   # expected alice, printed bob
